issues.issue: Whether the RPD unfairly drew a negative inference from the 2018 BOC amendment adding an omitted attack
issues.applicant_position: RPD breached procedural fairness; Rule 9 allows BOC amendments, so no negative inference should follow.
issues.result_text: No error: omission of a material incident could be considered, and RPD questioned the explanation.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in finding the appellants have substantially the same rights as Brazilian citizens
issues.applicant_position: Residence renewal depends on employment, so Haitians lack substantially similar status; RPD decision unintelligible.
issues.respondent_position: Minister sought rejection under Article 1E (para 9); no specific submission on this issue stated.
issues.result_text: Appellants have permanent status with substantially the same rights as Brazilian nationals; no error.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in assessing forward-looking risk in Brazil
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in assessing the forward-looking risk to her and her son in Brazil.
issues.result_text: Appellant failed to establish a serious possibility of persecution or systemic rights violations if returned.
